name: two devices change different fields of one row and both changes stay
the higher HLC wins a field whatever the order the changes arrive in
one millisecond and counter on two devices: the device id breaks the tie
a higher counter beats a higher device id in the same millisecond
a change that loses one field and wins another leaves the version of the lost one
a delete beats an update with a higher HLC whatever the order
an update that arrives after the delete does not bring the row back
a create with the id of a deleted row does not bring it back
delivering the same operation twice changes nothing
an update of a row that was never created is skipped
a row whose reference points to nothing is skipped
a change that points to nothing is skipped and the rest of its operation still applies
a link to a work deleted elsewhere is skipped, or removed when the work goes
an update of a row removed with its parent is skipped
two operations with one HLC: the second is refused and so are the later ones of its author
a work deleted while another device adds an edition to it: neither stays
a work deleted takes its edition and the copy of that edition with it, in any order
a publisher deleted while another device creates an edition naming it: the edition stays without a publisher
a publisher deleted while another device updates an edition to name it: the rest of the update applies
a member deleted while another device creates or updates a copy naming it as owner: the copy stays without an owner
a person deleted while another device links them to a work: the link goes, the work stays
